name: Galaxy Starry Sky Lamp Box | 2-in-1 Projector Night Light with 3  Projection Lenses | Built-in Night Light
description:
Create a relaxing and dreamy atmosphere with this 2-in-1 USB Galaxy Star Projector Night Light, designed with both a starry sky projector and night light function. It projects decorative starry effects onto walls and ceilings while providing soft illumination for dark indoor spaces.
Featuring interchangeable projection lenses, this compact projector lets you change the visual effect according to your preference. The USB-powered design makes it convenient to use with a laptop, power bank, USB adapter, or other compatible 5V USB power source. For the best projection effect, use it in a darker environment.
Ideal for bedrooms, children's rooms, home décor, KTV spaces, and relaxing nighttime settings, this mini projector adds a decorative touch while creating a cozy atmosphere.

Key Features
2-in-1 design with starry sky projector and night light
Includes interchangeable projection lenses for different effects
Creates beautiful galaxy and starry sky projections
Adjustable brightness for comfortable lighting
USB powered for convenient everyday use
Compact and easy-to-use design
Projects decorative effects onto walls and ceilings
Suitable for bedrooms, children's rooms, home décor, and KTV
Creates a relaxing and dreamy nighttime atmosphere
Best suited for use in dark indoor environments

Product Specifications
Product Type: Galaxy Star Projector & Night Light
Material: ABS Housing
Input Voltage: 5V
Projection Lamp Power: 1.75W
Night Light Power: 0.21W
Projection Lamp Current: 950mA
Night Light Current: 42mA
Power Supply: USB
Projection Lenses: 3

How to Use
Connect the projector to a compatible 5V USB power source
Select and install the desired projection lens
Place the projector facing a wall or ceiling
Turn on the projector and adjust the brightness as required
Use the night light function when soft illumination is preferred
For better projection effects, use the projector in a dark environment

Material / Composition
ABS Plastic Housing
LED Projection Light
Night Light
Interchangeable Projection Lenses
USB Power Connection

Safety Information
Use only with a compatible 5V USB power source
Do not expose the electrical components to water or moisture
Do not look directly into the LED light source
Keep away from excessive heat and direct flames
Keep out of reach of small children when not in use
Disconnect from the USB power source when not in use

Package Includes
1 × 2-in-1 USB Galaxy Star Projector Night Light
3 × Interchangeable Projection Lenses
